body.x: GOYANG, Korea (AVING Special Report on 'KES 2006') -- <Visual News> iCanTek presented 5mm-thick slim mouse at KES 2006. By employing an ultra-small optical module, this Korean venture company was able to produce this item, which is thin enough to be put in a sound card slot on the side of a laptop. Even the cable is also thin. Despite the unusual look, however, people can use it just like a general mouse by folding it; it has two buttons and one scroll wheel. The company plans to release this mouse in the market in November with its own brand name and for the optical engine it has applied for a patent and is waiting for an answer.
